type Id = `id-${number}`;
const id: Id = "id-1";
const ok: `user:id-${number}` = `user:${id}`;
const bad: `user:id-${number}` = `user-${id}`;
type N = `${`n${number}`}`;
const n: N = "n5";
const badN: N = "m5";
type B = `x${`${"p" | "q"}-${number}`}y`;
const badB: B = "xr-1y";
const lower: Lowercase<string> = "ab" as Uppercase<string>;
console.log(ok, bad, n, badN, badB, lower);
